resources.string: Choose an action, then press a button. Short and long presses can do different things. Mappings work while Cabin has focus, for buttons Android delivers to Cabin. Buttons handled by the car may not appear here.
The mapped app is unavailable. Choose another app in button settings.
Changes save automatically. Settings backup and restore includes both press types and app mappings.
Remove all short-press and long-press mappings in Cabin? Buttons return to their normal behavior. Factory steering learning is unchanged.
